cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: I’ve Done This Before
cards.instruction: Perform calm familiarity with the task while learning how it works from every new clue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. I'll make your coffee. I know this machine: this button starts it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's steam. The coffee button is behind the flap.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Naturally. Steam first, then the concealed coffee controls. Where's your cup?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Here. It makes two cups unless you turn that dial.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Dial to one. I always tailor the standard procedure to the guest.

mechanism: A claims taught procedure while absorbing each correction about an unfamiliar coffee machine as if it confirms its own method.
confusable: Unlike only pretending technical mastery, each new clue actually changes the steps A takes while its calm performance persists.
comparison: Sequential hidden controls versus distinguishing tent parts while correcting assembly.
seedUse: D42 steam/flap/two-cup dial already supplies actual learning; S05 near-my-way appropriates the useful correction as pupil progress.
